doctrine:
Scope: this worktree owns reduction of code, tests, gate work and API/binary surface through source-bound AST and control/data-flow analysis. Its plan contains only its own work. Master, GUI and audio campaigns remain in their originating worktrees. Removing their inherited rows here neither completes nor cancels them; Git and OvergoDB retain their history. Do not import another worktree's plan. The operator explicitly directed this correction after 9565ed5c.

Priority: analyze the complete gate cycle before choosing the next optimization. Rank avoidable execution, repeated analysis and recovery cost from retained attempts; distinguish actual execution from planned work, independent invalidators from overlapping reasons, and commit latency from completion of deferred obligations. Prove the cheapest sufficient simplification through existing AST, dependency and execution owners. Consolidate preparation, checks, admission and evidence reuse; delete displaced paths. Preflight and publication consume one recipe. Preserve independent oracles, exact input binding and durable recovery. Keep analysis and its selected bounded implementation in one integration boundary; do not pay a full gate merely to publish another analysis row. Reassess the remaining bottleneck after each measured change. Existing test-input, fixture and API work remains local; reconcile landed changes before repeating it.

Execution: codex-surface-lead owns this lane. Claim each integration boundary with role surface-area-reduction; keep commands and consoles in this worktree. Review existing committed implementations before writing alternatives. Port only reviewed relevant code, preserving caller migrations and local fixes; do not merge unrelated runtime, scheduling or acceptance policy. Dependencies name local producer steps, not source commits or foreign tasks. Continue by updating this plan when measured outcomes expose the next useful reduction; an empty dispatch is not completion of the broader objective.

Proof: use existing repoanalysis, codeprofile and codemanifest owners. Record changed source, build context, call/read/effect paths, independent invalidators and retained evidence. Sequence diagrams project those same facts; no separate graph authority. Missing or unresolved edges retain required coverage. Preserve independent numerical, cancellation, recovery and format oracles, fixture lifetimes and error paths. Compare complete caller migrations and net SLOC/AST, duplicate excess, exports, imports and link targets. A harness increase requires a measured total-cost benefit; renamed wrappers do not count as consolidation.

Acceptance: capability freeze enforced by structure. Each row retains its existing lower-bound checks. Bind concrete reduction and counterexample acceptance through validated plan -edit in the owning package before closure. Use plan -setverify when a separate local acceptance run is useful; do not repeat it merely to bind an already reviewed command. The publication gate still executes its mandatory acceptance against the frozen candidate; this scheduling change grants no evidence reuse or reduced acceptance. No zero-match, missing-fixture or skipped-case credit. UNAVAILABLE inputs are explicit obligations to find or construct with provenance. Cheap static checks precede expensive verification; exact prior evidence is reused only when every relevant input matches. Preserve required gates and commit through their existing owner. Do not weaken acceptance or use throughput alone to declare correctness failure. Publish measured results and outstanding obligations, then return to dispatch.
